applications.description: Applications to manage and keep running persistently.

name.description: Unique name for the application or task, used to label its launchd service.

command.description: Executable to run, either a name on the PATH or a path. A leading `~` is expanded to the home directory.

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the command. A leading `~`, or `~` directly after `=` (as in `--flag=~/path`), is expanded to the home directory.

ignorePatterns.description: Minimatch patterns to ignore when uploading logs. These are applied in addition to a default set of common patterns.

localPath.description: Local directory to upload logs from. A leading `~` is expanded to the home directory.

artifactPattern.description: Pattern matching the name of the release artifact to download.

destination.description: Where to install the downloaded artifact. A leading `~` is expanded to the home directory.

version.description: If not provided, the latest version will be used.
If not provided, the latest version will be used.

schedule.description: Applications must not define a schedule. Use a task instead.

offline.description: Don't wait around for internet access, skip operations that require it.

runOnStartup.description: Register itson to run on startup.

tasks.description: One-off tasks to run at specified times.
